name: Troy Carter
stance: Sponsors legislation for a CISA task force on AI safety and national security challenges.

statements.text: Introduced, with Rep. Bennie Thompson, the CISA Securing AI Task Force Act (H.R. 8348, 118th Congress) to establish a CISA task force on AI safety and security challenges.

Co-led, with Reps. Matsui, McClain Delaney and Landsman, a letter from 27 lawmakers urging Senate leadership to strike the reconciliation provision tying BEAD broadband funding to a ten-year moratorium on enforcing state AI laws.
Reintroduced, with Ranking Member Bennie Thompson, the CISA AI Task Force Act to establish a CISA task force on the safety and national security challenges of AI.
